mapper.select: select report.report_id as reportid, report.plan_id as planid, report.reporter_member_id as reportermemberid, member.member_name as reportername, plan.title as plantitle, report.reason_code as reasoncode, report.reason_detail as reasondetail, report.report_status as reportstatus, report.created_at as createdAt, report_process.process_result_code as processresultcode, report_process.process_reason as processreason, report_process.processed_at as processedat from report report join member member on member.member_id = report.reporter_member_id join travel_plan plan on plan.plan_id = report.plan_id left join report_process report_process on report_process.report_id = report.report_id where report.report_id = #{reportId}
mapper.insert: merge into report_process target using ( select CAST(#{reportId} AS NUMBER(19)) as report_id from dual ) source on (target.report_id = source.report_id) when matched then update set target.processor_admin_id = #{adminId}, target.process_result_code = #{processResultCode}, target.process_reason = #{processReason}, target.processed_at = #{processedAt} when not matched then insert ( report_id, processor_admin_id, process_result_code, process_reason, processed_at ) values ( #{reportId}, #{adminId}, #{processResultCode}, #{processReason}, #{processedAt} )
mapper.update: update report set report_status = #{reportStatus} where report_id = #{reportId}
update travel_plan set visibility = #{visibility}, version_no = version_no + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP where plan_id = #{planId}
